Show what the read tool will return for a path or URL

USAGE
  $ gjc read [PATH] [FLAGS]

ARGUMENTS
  PATH   Path or URL to read (append :sel for line ranges or raw mode, e.g. src/foo.ts:50-100)

FLAGS
      --truncation=<value>  Which end of an over-budget result to keep

EXAMPLES
  gjc read src/foo.ts
  gjc read src/foo.ts --truncation head
  gjc read src/foo.ts:50-100
  gjc read src/foo.ts:raw
  gjc read https://example.com
  gjc read path/to/archive.zip:dir/file.ts
  gjc read path/to/db.sqlite:users:42
